title: 第27章 公婆的理直气壮
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 咳咳！大队长清了清嗓，把院外的人遣散。“都别看了，不想走就留下来帮忙修院子吧。”赵小义砍的院子，让大伙修？没一分钟，周围人就全散了。“喜弟啊，赵小义也是因为他爹的事，一时情急。我已经让他回家借钱赔偿了，这次就饶过他一次。”“冤冤相报何时了，你就是把他送了公安，关个三五月他还要回来的，到时候这滚刀肉回来，砍的就不一定是院子。”“都是一条村的人，他今天也出气了，咱们就放过他一回，给他一次反思的机会。”“我这就去他家，做做思想教育？”队长打着马虎眼，就急急忙忙离开了。范金花去院里，翻着倒成一片的菜，努力挽救能挽救的。张国海这才从屋里出来，看着满院狼籍，冲着徐喜弟就怒骂。“瞧瞧，你非得招惹赵家。人家都给钱了事了，还闹！你以为关了赵丁就完了？他有儿子，还有个女儿！”“这回你收拾咯，赵小义要是不赔钱，我看你这院子怎么修！”骂完解气了，又背着手转身进屋，既不收拾院子，也不管篱笆院。巴儿姐吃完糍粑，两手在裤腿上搓了搓，也进屋去了。“喜弟，没事。小羊山背面正好有一些楠竹，我砍了还没烧。扛回来就能修院子，你们家院子也早该换新竹了。”刘烨把自己的农具往院角一放，就准备往小羊山走。“现在去吗？太阳已经下山了。”徐喜弟已经全克服了自己心里对他的羞涩。现在去扛竹子，回来只怕天都要黑透了。范金花一听刘烨要帮忙修院子，抬头看了他一眼。没说感谢，也没说管饭，又低头扶菜地了。刘烨说走就走，迈着大步就走。“我一起去帮忙吧。”徐喜弟说着要跟上。“你别去，这种体力活，你别粘手。我今天去扛一捆，明天再弄几捆，一天就能把篱笆院修起来。”刘烨连连摆手，不让徐喜弟去。看着远走的背影，她心里说不上什么滋味。但她知道，刘烨自己说要帮忙的，公婆大概也只会占下这个便宜。傻子！“妈，今晚我们煮烨叔的饭吧，不能让人白干活。”她说完，也不管范金花同意不同意，就进屋去煮饭。他们想占这个便宜，可她不能欺负别人傻憨。巴儿姐坐在灶边，烤第五个糍粑。仿佛这个家就是被砍平了，也跟她没关系。徐喜弟洗的米才下锅，张国海忽然跑出去和院里的范金花叽叽咕咕说了什么后，两口子一起来到火房。“你说你把钱退给了赵丁，你哪里来的钱？背着我们藏钱了？”徐喜弟要是偷偷藏钱，那还了得！她身上一分钱都不能有！“十八年，你吃我们的，穿我们的，怎么能背着我们藏钱？”“把钱都拿出来，否则今天没完。”张国海斜着眼，他现在憋着一肚子气。经过这几个晚上，他看徐喜弟已经不是那么回事了。指不定，徐喜弟的钱，就是别人夜里偷偷给的。都没安好心！必须要回来才行！徐喜弟无语地看着两口子，“家里卖点什么东西，不是经你们的手？”“十八年来，你们给过我几块钱去赶圩？”“那五十块，我跟刘宇宁借的，不信你们上他家问问，我写了条子的。”这个家，她一定不能待！必须尽快想办法，怎么攒钱，然后走得远远的！“写了条？借个五十块还写条？刘家抠成这样？真不是东西！”张国海生气的似乎不是借钱，而是刘家借一点钱还让她写条子。“他们又不欠咱们家的，这个时候肯借钱，已经是给了面子。钱还清就撕借条，有什么不对？”徐喜弟皱着眉，这一家子，把所有人的善意，都当成了理所当然？怎么就这样理直气壮？范金花不说话，张国海瞪了她好几个白眼，最后还是他来说。“你写的条，你自己还！跟我们没关系！”“赵小义要是给了八十块赔偿款，就拿五十还给刘家。”徐喜弟态度比从前硬了。一味顺从他们，她这辈子都别想离开张家！“那不行！赵小义赔的是修院子和修门的钱，不能给你拿去填那个窟窿！”张国海不肯。徐喜弟借刘家的钱，他一分都不想还！“不给我，那你们自己去要吧，看看赵小义给不给你们！”徐喜弟也不跟他们争执了。“别说八十块了，能从赵小义那里拿回来八块，都算我眼瞎。”那种胡搅蛮缠的主，不找个厉害的人出面，想从他身上拔毛，做梦去吧。张国海被噎得无话，赵家人，他一个都不敢招惹。“今晚在煮这么多饭做什么？”他的注意力突然又转到一锅米饭上。水开了，徐喜弟拿着木勺在里面搅拌，等米粒煮胀起来，到半熟，就可以把锅里多的水盛出来，然后退火等熟就可以了。看着比平日多出来半锅饭，张国海十分肉疼。“烨叔帮忙修院子，没钱给，饭总要管一顿。”徐喜弟应道。“他自己愿意帮忙……而且，修个院子能费多大劲？这点点忙，就管饭，当我们家大米自己在米缸里冒出来的吗？”徐喜弟看也不看张国海。自己也不知道怎么回事，这几天越来越反感这一家子人了。找人借种生孩子，他们没给什么好处，别人还倒帮忙割了猪菜。人家好心主动帮忙修院子，他们也觉得心安理得。“大米的确不是米缸里自己冒出来的，是烨叔牵自己家的牛，耕田种出来的。”徐喜弟站起身，去院里摘菜。张国海对着她的背影干瞪眼。“瞧瞧，瞧瞧，她现在向着谁说话？”他不满地斜了范金花一眼，“你就不该出这种馊主意！”“她知道自己生的不是我们张家的种，以后跟我们还能一条心？她要跟别人一条心去了！”“弄不好，是咱们给别人做嫁衣！”“馊主意！”范金花被他这么一说，脾气又上来了，“你有更好的主意？是你能生，还是我能生？”“不对，你是指定生不了，我倒是还可以……”
content_en: Ahem!The captain cleared his throat and dismissed the people outside the hospital."Don't even look at it. If you don't want to leave, just stay and help repair the yard." Zhao Xiaoyi cut the yard and let everyone repair it?Within a minute, everyone around them dispersed."Brother Xi, Zhao Xiaoyi was also in a hurry because of his father's affairs. I have asked him to go home and borrow money to pay compensation, so I will spare him this time." "When is the time to retaliate? If you send him to the police, he will be detained for three to five months and he will come back.When we come back, it’s not necessarily the yard that’s being chopped down.”“He’s from a village, and he got angry today. Let’s let him go and give him a chance to reflect.”“I’m going to go to his house for some ideological education?”the captain said in a hurry and left.Fan Jinhua went to the yard, turning over the vegetables that had fallen into pieces, trying to save what she could.Only then did Zhang Guohai come out of the room. Seeing the mess in the courtyard, he cursed at Xu Xidi angrily."Look, you have to provoke the Zhao family. They have already given money to solve the problem, and they are still making trouble! Do you think it's over after locking up Zhao Ding? He has a son and a daughter!" "You clean up this time. If Zhao Xiaoyi doesn't pay, I'll see how you can repair your yard!" After cursing, he turned around and went into the house with his hands behind his back, neither cleaning up the yard nor caring about the fence.After Sister Ba'er finished eating the glutinous rice cake, she rubbed her hands on her trouser legs and went into the house."Brother Xi, it's okay. There happened to be some phoebe bamboo on the back of Xiaoyang Mountain. I chopped it down before burning it. You can build the yard by carrying it back. Your yard should be replaced with new bamboo long ago." Liu Ye put his farm tools in the corner of the yard and prepared to go to Xiaoyang Mountain."Are you going now? The sun has already set." Xu Xidi had completely overcome her shyness towards him.Now I'm going to carry bamboo. I'm afraid it will be dark when I come back.When Fan Jinhua heard that Liu Ye wanted to help repair the yard, she raised her head and glanced at him.He didn't say thank you, nor did he say he was in charge of the food. He lowered his head and helped the vegetable patch again.Liu Ye left as soon as he said so, taking long strides."Let me go and help." Xu Xidi said and wanted to follow."Don't go. Don't let your hands get stuck in this kind of physical work. I'll carry one bundle today and a few more bundles tomorrow. I can build the fence yard in one day." Liu Ye waved his hands repeatedly to prevent Xu Xidi from going.Looking at the back of her walking away, she couldn't tell how she felt.But she knew that Liu Ye himself said he wanted to help, and his parents-in-law would probably only take advantage of this.Fool!"Mom, let's cook Uncle Ye's meal tonight. We can't let people work in vain." After she finished speaking, regardless of whether Fan Jinhua agreed or not, she went into the house to cook.They wanted to take advantage of this, but she couldn't bully others into being stupid.Sister Ba'er was sitting by the stove, baking the fifth glutinous rice cake.It seemed that even if the family was demolished, it had nothing to do with her.The rice washed by Xu Xidi was just put into the pot. Zhang Guohai suddenly ran out and chatted with Fan Jinhua in the courtyard, and the couple came to the fire room together."You said you returned the money to Zhao Ding. Where did you get the money? Did you hide the money behind our backs?" If Xu Xidi hid the money secretly, it would be a repayment!She can't have a penny on her!"For eighteen years, you have been eating from us and wearing our clothes. How can you hide money behind our backs?" "Take out all the money, otherwise the day will never end." Zhang Guohai squinted, he was holding back his anger.After these few nights, he saw that Xu Xidi was no longer like that.Maybe Xu Xidi's money was given secretly by others at night.No one has any good intentions!You have to come back!Xu Xidi looked at the couple speechlessly, "What is selling at home that doesn't go through your hands?" "How many dollars have you given me to go to the fair in the past eighteen years?" "I borrowed the fifty dollars from Liu Yuning. If you don't believe me, go to his house and ask, I wrote the note." She must not stay in this house!We must figure out how to save money as soon as possible and then go far!"Write a note? Borrow fifty yuan and write a note? The Liu family is so dignified? It's really not a thing!" Zhang Guohai seemed to be angry not for borrowing money, but because the Liu family borrowed a little money and asked her to write a note."They don't owe our family anything. If they are willing to lend money at this time, they have already given face. What's wrong with tearing up the IOU when the money is paid off?" Xu Xidi frowned. This family takes everyone's goodwill for granted?Why are you so confident?Fan Jinhua didn't speak, Zhang Guohai rolled his eyes at her several times, and finally it was he who spoke."You pay the note you wrote yourself! It has nothing to do with us!" "If Zhao Xiaoyi gives 80 yuan in compensation, he will give 50 yuan back to the Liu family." Xu Xidi's attitude is harder than before.If she just obeys them, she will never leave the Zhang family in her life!"That won't work! What Zhao Xiaoyi has to pay is the money for repairing the yard and the door. He can't give it to you to fill that hole!" Zhang Guohai refused.Xu Xidi borrowed money from the Liu family, but he didn't want to pay back any of it!"If you don't give it to me, then go and ask for it yourself and see if Zhao Xiaoyi gives it to you!" Xu Xidi stopped arguing with them."Don't talk about eighty yuan. If I can get eight yuan back from Zhao Xiaoyi, I will be blind." That kind of messy master will just dream if he doesn't find a powerful person to come forward and want to pluck the hair out of him.Zhang Guohai was choked and speechless. He did not dare to offend anyone in the Zhao family."What are you cooking so much for tonight?" His attention suddenly turned to the pot of rice.When the water boils, Xu Xidi stirs it with a wooden spoon. When the rice grains swell and are half cooked, he can take out the excess water in the pot, then anneal it and wait until it is cooked.Seeing that there was half a pot more rice than usual, Zhang Guohai felt very sad."Uncle Ye helps with the yard work. If he doesn't have any money, he has to take care of the food." Xu Xidi responded."He himself is willing to help...and how much effort does it take to build a yard? He is so busy and just takes care of the food. Do you think our rice just pops out of the rice vat?" Xu Xidi didn't even look at Zhang Guohai.I don’t know what’s going on, but I’ve become more and more disgusted with this family these days.When I asked someone to borrow seeds to have a baby, they didn't give me any benefits. Others even helped me cut pig vegetables.People kindly offered to help with yard repairs, and they felt at ease."Rice does not come out of the rice vat on its own. It is grown by Uncle Ye using his own cows to plow the fields." Xu Xidi stood up and went to the yard to pick vegetables.Zhang Guohai glared at her back."Look, look, who is she talking to now?" He glanced at Fan Jinhua with dissatisfaction, "You shouldn't have come up with such a bad idea!" "She knows that she is not a child of our Zhang family, can she still be one with us in the future? She is going to be with someone else!""It can't be done, let's make wedding clothes for others!""Bad idea!"Fan Jinhua became angry again when he said this, "Do you have a better idea? Is it better for you to give birth?""No, you are determined not to give birth, but I can still..."
